summary: Well-posed AAE-relevant question (per-building reliable intervals for buildings onboarding to DR/M&V platforms) with an unusually thorough evaluation (1,157 units, 5 seeds, leave-site-out, cross-country, stress tests, paired statistics). As submitted it carries clear desk-rejection risk: (1) the mechanism is conceded not to be new and the two claimed differentiators (LOBO-selected pseudo-count, kNN/stage refinements) are respectively beaten by and equivalent to a fixed pseudo-count from prior work; (2) the headline method and the 'pre-registered' framing do not match the evidence and changelog; (3) no energy-application payoff is quantified; (4) the manuscript is about twice the journal length. Internal number consistency is good.

issues.title: Claimed differentiator (LOBO-selected kappa) is beaten by a fixed kappa from prior work
issues.evidence: Sec 2.3 differentiates from [29] by selecting the pseudo-count by LOBO 'rather than fixing it'. Table 4: HSC-CQR fixed-kappa (kappa=168 h, the [29] mixture) has lower coverage deviation than tuned HSC-CQR on BDG2 (mean diff +0.0026, r_rb=-0.45, p<0.001); Table 5: fixed-kappa MACD 0.015 / 1.9% under-covered vs tuned 0.018 / 3.4%; indistinguishable on UCI. Fig 9: target MACD minimised at 96-168 h but LOBO on interval score selects 336 h. Abstract still calls the LOBO-tuned version 'the most reliable strategy'.
issues.action: Drop the LOBO-selection novelty claim, or show a selection objective that targets per-building reliability (LOBO on MACD/under-coverage, or constrained objective). Rewrite abstract/conclusion to credit the fixed-kappa donor-local mixture.
issues.experiment: Re-run LOBO selection with a coverage-deviation (or constrained IS) objective on cached scores; compare to fixed kappa=168.

issues.title: Headline numbers use the variant the paper calls unnecessary
issues.evidence: Abstract, Table 2, Table 4 and Fig 1 present HSC-CQR with kNN prior + stage matching while Highlight 5 and Sec 6.2 say these 'add nothing'; the recommended layer is 'simple' (MACD 0.017, under-cov 2.9%). The 0.437 ms abstract cost includes neighbour search. Fig 1 still diagrams kNN/stage. 'HSC simple' was added after the seed-0 full-run look (CHANGELOG).
issues.action: Recommend one method and report everything (abstract, Fig 1, paired tests, cost) for it; move refinements to ablation; consider renaming ('hierarchical' no longer descriptive).

issues.title: 'Pre-registered' overstated
issues.evidence: Sec 4.4: 'All settings were fixed in a pre-registration file before any full experiment was run.' PREREGISTRATION.md primary endpoint = interval score, hypothesis = kNN/stage HSC. CHANGELOG 2026-11-16: GHCP-CQR, QShrink-CQR, TQA-B-CQR, simple and fixed-kappa variants, MLP-CQR checks added after a full-run look; ACI gamma grid widened. Abstract leads with under-covered share (secondary threshold metric) while primary IS shows no difference (median 0.564 vs 0.564).
issues.action: Add a deviations table (each post-hoc baseline/variant/grid change, dates, reasons); label confirmatory vs exploratory; report primary endpoint first or justify the switch.

issues.title: No quantified energy-application payoff
issues.evidence: aae_benchmark.md conclusion 1 and selected_journal.md name 'ML-methods paper without energy-application impact' the main desk-rejection risk; DR baselines, flexibility bids and M&V appear only as motivation (Sec 1, 6.3). Improvement ~2 coverage points of MACD is not translated to settlement error, bid-violation cost or alarm false negatives.
issues.action: Add an operational case study (DR baseline settlement or flexibility bid with interval-violation penalty); compute per-method cost/violation distribution across buildings.
issues.experiment: Using stored intervals, simulate day-ahead flexibility commitments with under-delivery penalty; report cost distribution across buildings for CQR, QShrink, fixed-kappa, HSC-CQR.

issues.title: No benefit in the first week, which title and motivation emphasise
issues.evidence: Abstract: intervals needed 'from the first days'. Table 2 week-1 coverage HSC-CQR 0.885 vs CQR 0.892 (BDG2), 0.894 vs 0.900 (UCI). Fig 5a: HSC-CQR lowest of CQR methods on day 1 (~0.868). Sec 5.3 concedes it. Per-building week-1 under-coverage never reported; headline metrics average 56 days.
issues.action: Report per-building MACD and under-covered share for weeks 1 and 2 separately; reframe claims to where the gain appears (after ~1 week).
issues.experiment: Recompute per-building metrics on days 1-7 and 8-14.

issues.title: Manuscript far exceeds journal length
issues.evidence: Final_Manuscript.pdf 29 pages; body ~12,700 words, 11 figures, 8 tables; Table 4 has 40 rows, Table 7 45 rows. AAE ~10-15 printed pages.
issues.action: Cut to ~8,000 words and 6-7 display items; move Tables 6-8, full Table 7, Figs 2, 10, 11 to supplement; shorten Sec 2.

issues.title: Margins over closest competitors near noise floor
issues.evidence: MACD diff vs QShrink 0.0047 (BDG2) / 0.0028 (UCI); vs Self-CQR 0.0034 / 0.0028; QShrink seed s.d. 0.004; own sampling floor 0.0066 before autocorrelation (Limitation 8); abstract/highlights say 'most reliable'.
issues.action: Frame HSC, QShrink and fixed-kappa as roughly equivalent shrinkage strategies unless margins exceed seed variability and an autocorrelation-adjusted floor (block bootstrap).

issues.title: Closest prior art is a 2026 Zenodo software record and preprints
issues.evidence: [29] is a software deposit; [25],[26],[27],[49] are 2026 arXiv preprints carrying much of the positioning (Sec 2.3).
issues.action: State exactly what [29] contains and whether authors overlap; make contribution claims stand on peer-reviewed literature too.

issues.title: AI-use declaration covers research execution
issues.evidence: Declaration: AI used for 'literature screening, software development, execution of the experiments and drafting'; Elsevier declaration targets writing; research use belongs in Methods. Placeholder '(Authors: verify ...)' remains.
issues.action: Describe AI role in Methods with verification procedure; remove placeholder notes.

issues.title: Cost table means skewed by outlier
issues.evidence: T_efficiency: UCI seed 1 LightGBM training 1317 s vs 27-52 s other seeds; Table 8 mean 298 s; HSC update 0.17-0.64 ms.

issues.title: Fig 11 does not show the claimed effect
issues.evidence: CQR and HSC-CQR bounds nearly overlap over first 10 days; misses almost all shared.
issues.action: Use days 1-56 or a building where shrinkage changes coverage, or drop it.
